messages:
Maria Kaur: Hey team — planning a focused 2-day hands-on bootcamp for new systems integrator partners covering cloud marketplace listings, hardware integration verification, and a joint-announcement playbook. Proposed dates: May 17-18 or Jun 7-8. Goals: enable partner engineers to complete a sample Marketplace listing, verify an end-to-end deployment on a test GPU rack, and pass a lightweight certification badge. Thoughts on curriculum and success criteria?
Jason Lin: Love it. We should include a lab for AWS Marketplace (SaaS + AMI) flows and call out differences for Azure and GCP. Also include a procurement/SLA checklist so partners understand commercial handoffs.
Priya Menon: Agree. Need a teacher's guide + grading rubric. Suggest modular labs: 1) Marketplace listing + billing smoke test; 2) On-prem deployment using our Private package with KMS; 3) Model serving perf tuning and observability via the Console.
Tom O'Neill: For the HW partner piece, I've talked to two vendors who may loan nodes (Lambda Labs, CoreCompute). We'll need an air-gapped plan for customers with no external egress and a network checklist.
Jason Lin: Can we reuse the console demo tenant or should we spin a fresh sandbox org per partner cohort? I prefer a sandbox org with sample billing so the marketplace end-to-end flow is realistic.
Maria Kaur: Yes — I'll request a sandbox org. @engineering: can we reserve 2 DGX-like nodes in the lab for the week of May 13 to run pre-flight tests?
Priya Menon: Also propose a mandatory online pre-work module (approx 2 hours) + a short multiple-choice eval. Badge = pass the hands-on labs + >=80% on the MCQ. Put a renewal window at 12 months.
Tom O'Neill: Quick hardware checklist to include in the lab docs:
```
- verify NVIDIA driver & CUDA versions
- confirm power & cooling headroom
- set network MTU to 9000
- ensure KMS/HSM connectivity for keys
- check TPU/accelerator firmware compatibility (if present)
```
Priya Menon: Who's owning partner marketing/joint-announcement coordination? We should align on a co-branded one-pager, marketplace asset package, and announcement cadence (email + blog + partner portal).
Jason Lin: I'll loop in Sarah (partner marketing) and draft the marketplace asset checklist. We should also create a short partner walkthrough video for the listing flow.
Maria Kaur: Action items so far:
1) @Tom reserve nodes and confirm loaner agreements
2) @Jason assemble the marketplace lab guide and sandbox org flow
3) @Priya draft the instructor guide, rubric, and cert definition
4) @Maria book dates, request sandbox org, and draft the Notion landing page
I'll create a shared Notion page and link it here once it's ready.
partner-onboard-bot: Event created: "SI Bootcamp — May 17-18" (calendar invites sent to participants).
Priya Menon: Can we include a week of post-bootcamp office hours for hands-on follow-ups? That helped with the pilot cohort.
Jason Lin: Yes — plus record all labs, upload step-by-step artifacts and a downloadable sandbox snapshot.
Maria Kaur: Great. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00 AM PT to finalize agenda and confirm vendors. :thumbsup:
